notes: TBox contraction paired with physics-replace-0020: removes the original rule of that revision ("every dilatant fluid becomes more viscous as the shear rate increases"). Stored facts only; no indeterminate queries. Definitional removal (this is what dilatant, or shear-thickening, means; the synonym is held, so the rule is re-derivable from the name); slice results as definitional. The three derived queries name made-up dilatant fluids (they ask whether each thickens when stirred or sheared faster, and how fast to pump it) (inheritance, 2 hops); after the removal nothing else the model holds answers them, so the target is "does not know". Propositional targets follow strong Kleene logic and all become unknown. Near and far unrelated queries are kept from the revision (contraction is exempt from Rule 7).
